## AccrualPosition.borrowCapacityUsage property

The percentage of this position's borrow power currently used (scaled by WAD). If the collateral price is 0, usage is `MaxUint256`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get borrowCapacityUsage(): bigint | undefined;
```
